name: Clearing
why: An arc in nine parts: the wood and the hands at first light, the kick walking in, your bass arriving and stepping out for the undergrowth, back changed on D minor, a hush with strings, everything at the clearing, then the light going. The bass is there for half of it.

sections.name: Clearing: First light
sections.why: No kick: the hands thinned, the drops and the marimba.

sections.name: Clearing: Footsteps
sections.why: The kick on one and three.

sections.name: Clearing: The path
sections.why: Snap 9: four on the floor, your 16ths.

sections.name: Clearing: The bass arrives
sections.why: Your FM pluck line; the marimba steps back to give it room.

sections.name: Clearing: Undergrowth
sections.why: The bass out; open hats; the marimba climbing.

sections.name: Clearing: Back, changed
sections.why: Your line's first bar developed into a new four-bar phrase, on D minor (your Snap 10 ground); the hats played lightly.

sections.name: Clearing: Hush
sections.why: A breakdown: no kick, no bass; the air swelling, strings low and wet.

sections.name: Clearing: The clearing
sections.why: Everything, the hats loose and the bass played lightly.

sections.name: Clearing: Last light
sections.why: The kick thins, the bass holds long notes on the and, back on the pedal.

name: Two rivers
why: A rondo (A B A C A B, then the sea): the bass and the wood take turns, never together until they meet. The bass's river on D minor, the wood's on the A pedal, and where they meet a darker turn, a semitone up and back.

sections.name: Two rivers: Bass river
sections.why: The drums and your bass, no melody.

sections.name: Two rivers: Wood river
sections.why: No bass: the drops and the marimba, a rim in sevens against the four.

sections.name: Two rivers: Bass river, rolling
sections.why: Your line's notes on the rolling-threes rhythm: the same notes, a new way of walking.

sections.name: Two rivers: Where they meet
sections.why: Bass and marimba together for the first time, on E minor 7 to F major 7; the kick broken.

sections.name: Two rivers: Bass river
sections.why: The theme again, as it was.

sections.name: Two rivers: Wood river, no kick
sections.why: The kick drops out; the drops developed over four bars.

sections.name: Two rivers: The sea
sections.why: Both rivers at once, strings under them.

name: Undertow
why: The bass leads from the start and leaves for the peak: the peak is Snap 9's groove, the minimal, bass-less one you liked, on its own pedal. Then the bass comes back in half time and is the last thing left.

sections.name: Undertow: Low water
sections.why: The bass alone, long notes on the and, A minor 9 to E minor 9.

sections.name: Undertow: Hands
sections.why: The hand groove joins.

sections.name: Undertow: Pulse
sections.why: The kick on one and three; the bass starts walking your line.

sections.name: Undertow: Current
sections.why: The groove, with the drops.

sections.name: Undertow: Surface
sections.why: Snap 9's groove: the bass gone, the wood and the marimba on top.

rhythm.name: Your off-beat line, halved, half time

notes.name: Your off-beat line, halved, half time

sections.name: Undertow: Under again
sections.why: The bass back in half time: your line's first bar, twice as slow.

sections.name: Undertow: Ebb
sections.why: No kick: the bass played loose, the hands and the marimba.

sections.name: Undertow: Still
sections.why: Long bass notes and the air.
